explication: Aves is an Android gallery and metadata explorer built with Flutter. Users browse and search a media collection, inspect media and metadata, and use Android integrations such as the picker, widgets, and screen saver. The supplied tree is Android-side code, so Flutter screens and the full user-facing navigation flow are not represented. The graph includes documented capabilities and sampled Android components; some internal feature wiring is unsampled and is therefore left unconnected.
